info.title: Flood Forecast API - River Discharge & Flood Risk Monitoring
info.description: Get daily flood risk and river discharge forecast data for any location, up to 16 days ahead. Returns a `location` block plus a `forecast` object keyed by date, each day carrying river discharge statistics (`river_discharge`, mean, median, max, min, and the p25/p75 percentiles) in m³/s. Accepts the target location as a `location` string, `lat`/`long` coordinates, or an `ip` address; the `timezone` param controls the returned timezone abbreviation. If none of `location`, `lat`/`long`, or `ip` are supplied, the location is auto-detected from the caller's IP address. Locations without a nearby monitored river return a `200` response with all discharge values at `0` rather than an error.

get.summary: Get flood risk and river discharge forecast
get.description: Provides flood forecast data for a given location, including river discharge metrics such as mean, median, maximum, minimum, and percentile values (p25, p75). Requires a startDate and endDate, with the date range limited to 16 days. Location can be specified using city name, latitude/longitude, or IP address; if omitted entirely, the caller's IP is used.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Starting date for flood forecast data in YYYY-MM-DD format. Forecast dates must be current or future dates only. Past dates are not allowed for forecast data. The difference between endDate and startDate must not exceed 16 days.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date for flood forecast data in YYYY-MM-DD format. Forecast dates must be current or future dates only. Past dates are not allowed for forecast data. The difference between endDate and startDate must not exceed 16 days.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City name, place name, or full address.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IP(v4 or v6) address for location inference.

parameters.name: precision
parameters.description: Forecast data granularity. Only 'daily' is supported; any other value returns a 400 error.

noRiverDataNearby.summary: Location with no nearby monitored river

400.description: Bad Request — Missing, malformed, or out-of-range parameters

InvalidCoordinates.summary: Latitude or longitude out of range

value.message: Invalid latitude or longitude values. Latitude must be between -90 and 90, and longitude must be between -180 and 180

UnresolvedCoordinates.summary: In-range coordinates over open ocean/uninhabited area

value.message: Please provide both lat and long parameters.
'hourly' precision is not supported on this endpoint
startDate must be in yyyy-mm-dd format
startDate must be before or equal to endDate

DateRangeExceeded.summary: Date range exceeds 16 days, or a past date was requested

value.message: Forecast date range must be within 2026-07-24 to 2026-08-08

404.description: Not Found — Location could not be resolved

locality.description: Specific locality, neighborhood, district, or village name within the broader area.
